captions.main: All your AI agents, one Dynamic Island.
captions.sub: Terminals, desktop apps, IDEs — every running session lives in the notch.
When an agent needs permission, it pops up right here. No context switching.
Finished tasks surface automatically — no hunting through terminal tabs.

restartHint: Restart any running sessions, or start a new one.
